LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Gizmo_SendDesc: Send whatever is loaded in this gate to a ruin's broken gate, or step it across to another open gate on this map.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Gizmo_ConnectDesc: Send whatever is loaded in this broken gate back through a colony gate that is open. All ruin guardians must be cleared before it can open. The crossing costs what a crossing out costs, paid from that gate's network, and this gate will not survive it.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Inspect_Starved: Open, but the network cannot pay its {0} mana/s upkeep
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Inspect_Unlinked: Open, but no mana node within {0} cells
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Inspect_RuinedLocked: Broken: locked while ruin guardians remain
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_RuinHostiles: Clear the ruin's guardians before opening this gate home.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NoTransporter: This gate has no transport compartment.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Empty: Nothing is loaded in the gate. Load people and cargo first.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NoHomeGate: No colony gate is open. Bring one online, or form a caravan and walk back.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NoRuin: No ruin can be reached. Seek one at a second-tier altar first.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_ReturnNeeds: — {1} has {2} mana stored and needs {0}; form a caravan and walk back
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Sent: {0} pawns and {1} kg of cargo arrive at {3} for {2} mana.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Returned: {0} things come home to {1} for {2} mana, and the broken gate falls apart behind them.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_ReturnCost: The crossing home needs {0} mana from {1}'s network, and {2} is stored. Nothing was moved or spent; form a caravan and walk back.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Gone: The gate or its far end is gone.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NoAnchor: {0} has no gate to arrive at; the connection was refused.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_CannotConnect: {0} cannot take a connection now ({1}). Nothing was moved or spent.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NoRoom: No room to land everything at {0}: {1} of {2} things found no free cell within {3} cells. Nothing was moved or spent.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NeedsParty: Load at least one standing colonist. The first crossing generates the ruin's map, and a map left with nobody on it is abandoned.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_Widened: Nothing fit beside {0}, so the party landed on the nearest free ground, up to {1} cells away.
LanguageData.WotF_TeleportGate_NoLanding: The connection to {0} was refused: {1} of the party found no free ground anywhere on the map.
